    • transparantSurrounding

      public static BufferedImage transparantSurrounding(BufferedImage centerpiece)
      Makes a transparant surrounding image of the main centerpiece glyph image. This will perhaps become useful. The idea behind this fetaure is that absolutism is bad and non-probable so to cover boundary cases when rendering it will be necessary to clobber a little outside the ordinary rectangular image. Think integral limits and the likes.
      Parameters:
      The - image that should be centered within this surounding.
